gloss: to be compatible; to go well together

definitions.gloss: to be compatible; to get along well; to be a good match
definitions.explanation: Describes a natural compatibility between people, things, or combinations. Can refer to personal relationships, food pairings, technology compatibility, and more.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相性|あいしょう}がいい。
examples.english: Those two are compatible with each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相性|あいしょう}がいい。
examples.english: Cheese and wine go well together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ソフトウェア→ソフトウェア：04719_sofutowea⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相性|あいしょう}がいいようで、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{動|うご}いている→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: The new software seems to be compatible with this computer — it's running without any problems.

notes:
⟦{相性|あいしょう}→相性：13654_aishou⟧ originally comes from fortune-telling and astrology, where it referred to the compatibility between two people's birth signs. Today it is used broadly for any kind of natural compatibility or affinity.

The opposite expression is ⟦{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い→相性が悪い：22140_aishougawarui⟧ (to be incompatible).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {相性|あいしょう}がいい: compatible, a good match
- ⟦{相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い→相性が悪い：22140_aishougawarui⟧: incompatible, a bad match
- ⟦{相性|あいしょう}→相性：13654_aishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to be compatible
- ⟦{相性|あいしょう}→相性：13654_aishou⟧⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧: perfect compatibility
- ⟦{相性|あいしょう}→相性：13654_aishou⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧: compatibility test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}が{合|あ}う→気が合う：22839_kigaau⟧: to get along — focuses on personality and temperament between people
- ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to hit it off — an idiomatic expression for personal chemistry
- ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to suit, to match — a more general term for things fitting together
